# Dropdown menu

A menu of actions opened from a button.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill">In Dense data</span></p>

## When to use it

**In Dense data:** Row actions.

- **Use it when:** More actions than fit, or actions people use now and then.
- **Not when:** Choosing a value for a field (select), or the one main action (a button).

Instead:

- [Select](./select.md): Choosing a value.
- [Context menu](./context-menu.md): The same menu on right-click.

## Words

- Lead with the object, then the state: "Alert 2041 contained."
- Use numbers, not words for numbers.
- One verb per button. No "please", no exclamation marks.
- Use: Investigate, Filter, Assign, Escalated, Resolved. Avoid: Oops, Awesome, Please, Simply.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Save
- `content.action.cancel`: Cancel
- `content.action.destroy`: Delete
- `content.action.retry`: Retry
- `content.action.empty-action`: Change filters

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add dropdown-menu
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Tokens it reads

Dropdown menu reads 4 tokens of its own, each an alias of a semantic token. Each row is one part: its own token, the semantic it aliases, and the value it ends at. A row marked Themeable changes between light and dark. Change a semantic and every component that reads it follows; override one of Dropdown menu's tokens to change Dropdown menu alone.
